about:
We perform all aspects of dentistry, with a focus on healthy, well-designed smiles. We also practise holistic dentistry — non-toxic materials chosen so that what goes in your mouth does not work against the rest of you.

Dr. Nasrin Mojaver has over 18 years of experience, and has invested in the equipment that actually changes how a visit feels: a Solea laser that does most fillings with no needle and no drill, CEREC 3D so a crown is finished the same day, and an iTero scanner so nobody has to bite into a tray of paste.

If you have been avoiding the dentist, this is the practice built for you.

reviews.text: I actually found Dr. Mojaver through Google search, but I was very grateful because, from my first day here, I felt very comfortable and very happy with Dr. Mojaver as my dentist.
reviews.author: Meredith

reviews.text: The entire team is very friendly and personable, remembering details about my life and asking me about them. Whenever I walk in, I don’t even have to give my name. That’s my kind of place. Good people and great work.
reviews.author: Amandine B.

reviews.text: I love going to Pearl Dentistry — the staff is friendly and it’s like a little party every time I visit. I have been to dental offices that have left my teeth hurting.
reviews.author: Dana M.
